messages:
alex: Hey folks — PR #8453 is blocked by a failing smoke test in CI, can someone take a quick look? I can't repro locally. https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8453 :wave:
ci-bot: CI run 1766012345 for PR #8453 finished with failures. Failed job: windows-e2e-smoke (agent-3). Failing test: smoke::end_to_end_login. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/1766012345/jobs/58
jordan: ack, looking now. Do we think this is a flake or a real regression?
mina: quick glance at the logs — looks like a timeout waiting for the auth popup: `TimeoutError: element not found after 30s`. Could be env slowness.
samir: @jordan @mina if it's a timeout, can we rerun the job once before doing deeper debugging? sometimes the Windows lab is noisy.
alex: re-run kicked off: `./scripts/ci rerun 1766012345 --job windows-e2e-smoke`
ci-bot: Re-run queued (rerun-1766012357).
ci-bot: Re-run completed. windows-e2e-smoke failed again. Same test: `smoke::end_to_end_login`. Snippet from failure:
```
Waiting for selector "#login-popup" failed: timeout 30000ms exceeded
Error: TimeoutError: element not found after 30000ms
at page.waitForSelector (/workspace/node_modules/playwright-core/...)
```
lee: hmmm I've seen that exact failure earlier this week — flaky popup due to a race when a new telemetry banner ships. There's an open PR that increases the login wait and fixes flakiness (see PR #8420).
jordan: can we try merging the branch onto main (rebase) to pick up the fix from #8420? or just bump the timeout in this branch temporarily to green the run.
mina: rebase probably fine. If rebase isn't possible quickly, adding a small timeout bump in `tests/smoke/login.test.ts` (from 30s -> 45s) will probably make this pass and unblock. We should follow up with a proper fix linked to #8420.
samir: adding `hold-merge` label until we confirm. @alex please confirm if we should hold or force-merge.
alex: hold merge for now. I'll rebase onto main and push, then trigger CI.
alex: pushed rebased branch -> triggering CI: `./scripts/ci run pr 8453`
ci-bot: CI run 1766012459 started.
ci-bot: CI run 1766012460 completed — windows-e2e-smoke: PASSED ✅. All other jobs green.
jordan: nice, tests passed after rebase. Looks safe to remove `hold-merge` and merge once you have one approval.
lee: fwiw we should track the flaky popup in the flaky-tests board (infra/flaky-tests) — I'll open a short follow-up ticket linking #8420 and these logs.
alex: thanks everyone — unholding and requesting final approval. @mina can you take approval?
mina: LGTM, approving now. :thumbsup:
alex: merging — thanks for the quick turnaround.
